column2: HR teams handle government IDs, salaries and home addresses every day. And those files keep getting pasted into cloud AI.
This is Gel. Private AI that runs on your Mac.
Press Option Space, and ask in Taglish.
Gel answers with its sources, right on this Mac.
Click a source, and the exact passage opens, highlighted.
Sharing files? Gel finds the IDs, names and salaries, and blacks them out. Originals stay untouched.
Now copy an employee record into Chat G P T. Gel catches it before you paste, and Option Command V pastes placeholders instead.
Speech, O C R, search and answers all run locally. The cloud only sees redacted text, and only if you allow it.
Gel. Private AI for your files.
